description: This file defines the Gdpr model class for managing GDPR-related database operations in an OpenCart module, including adding, updating, retrieving GDPR records, and fetching expiration data.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Provides methods to manage GDPR-related records in the database

methods.name: addGdpr
methods.description: Creates a new GDPR record in the database with specified code, email, and action.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing GDPR record identified by GDPR ID.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its GDPR ID.

methods.name: getGdprByCode
methods.description: Fetches GDPR record based on a unique code.

methods.name: getGdprsByEmail
methods.description: Returns all GDPR records associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records that are expiring based on status and date conditions.
